verdict.rationale: Honcho is a memory layer, so on-demand memory deletion is a fair question to ask of it, but the evidence pack never documents deleting a single memory, a per-peer representation, or a full workspace. Self-hosting to keep data on your own infrastructure is an adjacent privacy control, not a deletion capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can delete a user's memories on demand — single memory, per-entity, or full erasure — to satisfy privacy requirements
